name: Sleep Scheduler
author: Lexodeus

publish.description: Schedule times for the Steam Deck to go to sleep and wake up.

Changelog:
## 0.1.1 (2026-10-24)

- Pick a date as well as a time, up to 30 days ahead. It starts on today, and a time that has already passed today moves to tomorrow.

### Fixes

- Choosing an hour, minute or AM/PM now sticks instead of jumping back to the starting time.
